recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, desaturated urban scene featuring a central figure in orange prison trousers and handcuffs sitting on a concrete block, flanked by two standing security guards in dark uniforms against a backdrop of a fenced prison yard.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure as the focal point of a triangular composition
Guards providing vertical framing and authority presence
High-contrast lighting emphasizing textures of concrete and fabric
Symmetrical arrangement of figures against an industrial background
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette with high-visibility orange as the sole pop
Low-angle perspective looking up at the subjects
Harsh, overhead sunlight creating deep shadows
Industrial textures like chain-link fence and cinder blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is seated centrally in the lower-middle foreground; secondary subjects stand behind him, forming a pyramid.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange trousers of the seated figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the orange center, moves up to the guards' faces, then out to the wide-tracked display text across the middle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open concrete ground in the foreground and bright, washed-out sky/walls in the background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated beige and grey for the environment and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for uniforms and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange for the inmate's trousers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) background with low saturation; high saturation reserved for the central clothing item.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to sepia-toned greys and one primary accent

letterConstructionRules: Header text uses a heavy, slab-like serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Thin, elegant serifs for the central horizontal text
Bold, blocky serifs for the top artist name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab-serif for the name paired with a light, widely-spaced serif for the title to create a sense of scale and tension.

preserve: Extreme tracking on the middle text
Bold slab-serif for the top name

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and authority for the top header.
Provides the thin, elegant contrast for the widely spaced middle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated photo of a man in orange prison pants and handcuffs sitting on a cinder block in a prison yard, with two guards standing behind him. The lighting should be harsh midday sun.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold slab-serif title at the top center. Add a second line of text across the middle of the image using a light serif font with very wide letter spacing. Place a standard parental advisory logo at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the orange color the only high-saturation element?
Is the middle text tracking wide enough to span the width of the subjects?

adjustableVariables: Width of the letter spacing in the subtitle
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Any specific law enforcement badges or logos
The exact wording of the artist and title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the handcuffs are visible and central to the narrative.
Check that the text does not obscure the faces of the subjects.
Verify the desaturation doesn't lose detail in the shadows.
Confirm the orange pants are the primary visual anchor.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Grit + High-Tracking Serif + Desaturated Palette + Single Color Pop
